33.content:
### AWS Relational Database Service

Take a deep look into the aspects of your RDS instances. Look for increases in CPU and memory utilization based on the connections to each instance. Visualize network throughput and latencies for a more thorough understanding. 

Inspect the selected instances in the [Clouds App](/ui/intent/dynatrace.clouds/view_aws_service/#{"dt.timeframe":{"to":"$dt_timeframe_to","from":"$dt_timeframe_from"},"explorer.type":"databases","dt.smartscape.aws_rds_dbinstance":"$InstanceSmartscapeId"}).

---

50.title: Database instances
50.query:
smartscapeNodes "AWS_RDS_DBINSTANCE"
| fieldsAdd name
| fieldsAdd aws.object
| filter in(aws.account.id, array($AccountId))
| filter in(aws.region, array($Region))
| filter (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array(""))))
| filter in(toString(id), array($InstanceSmartscapeId))
| parse aws.object, "JSON:json"
| fieldsAdd engine = json[configuration][engine]
| fields name, engine
| summarize count()

51.title: Database instances by class

smartscapeNodes "AWS_RDS_DBINSTANCE"
| fieldsAdd aws.resource.name
| fieldsAdd aws.object
| filter in(aws.account.id, array($AccountId))
| filter in(aws.region, array($Region))
| filter (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array(""))))
| filter in(toString(id), array($InstanceSmartscapeId))
| parse aws.object, "JSON:json"
| fieldsAdd class = json[configuration][dbInstanceClass]

70.content:
### Log Analytics

Log distribution, volume trends, error breakdowns, patterns, and live tail. [Get deeper insights in Logs app](/ui/intent/dynatrace.logs/view_query/#%7B%22dt.query%22%3A%22fetch%20logs%2C%20scanLimitGBytes%3A100%5Cn%7C%20filter%20in%28toString%28dt.smartscape_source.id%29%2C%20array%28splitString%28%5C%22$InstanceSmartscapeId%5C%22%2C%20%5C%22%2C%5C%22%29%29%29%5Cn%7C%20filter%20in%28aws.account.id%2C%20array%28splitString%28%5C%22$AccountId%5C%22%2C%20%5C%22%2C%5C%22%29%29%29%5Cn%7C%20filter%20in%28aws.region%2C%20array%28splitString%28%5C%22$Region%5C%22%2C%20%5C%22%2C%5C%22%29%29%29%5Cn%7C%20filter%20status%20%3D%3D%20%5C%22ERROR%5C%22%5Cn%7C%20sort%20timestamp%20desc%22%2C%22dt.timeframe%22%3A%7B%22from%22%3A%22$dt_timeframe_from%22%2C%22to%22%3A%22$dt_timeframe_to%22%7D%2C%22showDqlEditor%22%3Atrue%7D).

---

72.title: Log level distribution
72.description: Share of log records per severity level.
72.query:
timeseries count = sum(dt.log.status_per_entity_count),
      by: {status},
      filter:{
        (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array("")))) AND in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($InstanceSmartscapeId)[])))      
      }
  | fieldsAdd total = arraySum(count)
  | filter total > 0
  | sort total desc
  | fields status, total

74.title: Error and warning log patterns (last 15 minutes)
74.description:
**Query Explanation:**

This DQL query identifies recurring `ERROR` and `WARN` log patterns for selected Amazon RDS instances. It fetches logs for the selected RDS Smartscape IDs, AWS account and region, then normalizes the raw log content to reduce high-cardinality noise caused by values such as UUIDs, ARNs, timestamps, client IP addresses, hexadecimal values, durations and numeric identifiers.

Logs are grouped by normalized pattern, status and DB instance. For each recurring pattern, the query keeps the RDS instance with the highest number of occurrences, helping identify which database instance is most affected by a repeated issue. Results are sorted by frequency and include a sample raw log entry to support investigation.
74.query:
fetch logs, scanLimitGBytes: 100
| filter (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array("")))) AND in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($InstanceSmartscapeId)[])))
| filter in(aws.account.id, array($AccountId))
| filter in(aws.region, array($Region))
| filter in(status, array("ERROR", "WARN"))

| fieldsAdd `DB instance` = coalesce(
    aws.resource.name,
    aws.resource.id,
    toString(dt.smartscape_source.id)
  )

| fieldsAdd pattern = toString(content)

// Normalize high-cardinality identifiers first
| fieldsAdd pattern = replacePattern(pattern, "UUIDSTRING", "<UUID>")
| fieldsAdd pattern = replacePattern(pattern, "'arn:' NSPACE+", "<ARN>")

// Normalize timestamps commonly present in database logs
| fieldsAdd pattern = replacePattern(pattern, "(ISO8601|HTTPDATE|JSONTIMESTAMP|TIMESTAMP|TIME)", "<TIME>")
| fieldsAdd pattern = replacePattern(pattern, "INT ':' INT ':' INT '.' INT", "<TIME>")

// Normalize network values such as client addresses
| fieldsAdd pattern = replacePattern(pattern, "IPADDR", "<IP>")

// Normalize explicit hex values, transaction IDs, LSN-like values and memory addresses
| fieldsAdd pattern = replacePattern(pattern, "'0x' HEXINT", "<HEX>")

// Normalize SQL statement durations and numeric values
| fieldsAdd pattern = replacePattern(pattern, "INT '.' INT", "<NUMBER>")
| fieldsAdd pattern = replacePattern(pattern, "DIGIT+", "<NUMBER>")

// Normalize whitespace
| fieldsAdd pattern = replacePattern(pattern, "SPACE+", " ")

| summarize `Occurrences in DB instance` = count(),
    `Log sample` = takeAny(content),
    by: {
      pattern,
      status,
      `DB instance`
    }

| filter `Occurrences in DB instance` > 1

// Keep the DB instance with the highest occurrence count for each pattern and status
| dedup { pattern, status }, sort: { `Occurrences in DB instance` desc, `DB instance` asc }

| sort `Occurrences in DB instance` desc
| limit 100

| fields `Occurrences in DB instance`,
    status,
    pattern,
    `DB instance with most occurrences` = `DB instance`,
    `Log sample`

75.title: Live log stream (last 15 minutes)
75.description:
**Query Explanation:**

This DQL query fetches the 100 most recent logs for selected Amazon RDS instances. It filters logs by selected RDS Smartscape ID, AWS account and AWS region. The query displays the raw log content as `Log message` without parsing or transforming the payload. It also derives a readable `DB instance` value from available AWS resource metadata, falling back to the Smartscape source ID when no resource name is available. Results are sorted by timestamp descending and show the key fields needed for live troubleshooting: time, status, log message, DB instance, AWS resource ID and Smartscape source ID.
75.query:
fetch logs, scanLimitGBytes: 100
| filter (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array("")))) AND in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($InstanceSmartscapeId)[])))
| filter in(aws.account.id, array($AccountId))
| filter in(aws.region, array($Region))

| fieldsAdd `Log message` = toString(content)
| fieldsAdd `DB instance` = coalesce(
    aws.resource.name,
    aws.resource.id,
    toString(dt.smartscape_source.id)
  )

| sort timestamp desc
| limit 100

| fields timestamp = formatTimestamp(timestamp, format: "HH:mm:ss a"),
    status,
    `Log message`,
    `DB instance`,
    `Resource id` = aws.resource.id,
    dt.smartscape_source.id

76.title: Log volume
76.description:
**Query Explanation:**

This DQL query shows log volume over time by status for the selected Amazon RDS instances. It uses the `dt.log.status_per_entity_count` metric and groups results by log status, such as `ERROR`, `WARN`, `INFO` and `NONE`. The query filters the data to the selected RDS Smartscape IDs (`$InstanceSmartscapeId`), making the result specific to the selected database instances.

A custom `sort_order` field is added to control how statuses are displayed in the dashboard. Statuses are ordered by severity, with `ERROR` and `WARN` prioritized above informational or empty-status logs. This makes it easier to quickly assess whether selected RDS instances are producing warning or error logs during the selected timeframe.

80.title: Error logs
80.description:
**Query Explanation:**

This DQL query shows the number of `ERROR` logs over time for the selected Amazon RDS instances. It uses the `dt.log.status_per_entity_count` metric and groups the result by Smartscape source ID, so each selected RDS instance is represented as a separate time series. The query filters the data to the selected RDS Smartscape IDs (`$InstanceSmartscapeId`) and includes only logs with `ERROR` status. The number of returned series is controlled by the `$Limit` dashboard variable.

To make the result easier to read in a dashboard, the query performs a lookup against AWS RDS Smartscape nodes and resolves each Smartscape source ID to the corresponding database instance name. The resolved name is exposed as `aws.resource.name`, while intermediate lookup fields and the raw Smartscape source ID are removed from the final result.
80.query:
timeseries count = sum(dt.log.status_per_entity_count),
    by: { dt.smartscape_source.id },
    filter: {
        (matchesValue($PrimaryTag,"ANY") or arraySize(array($PrimaryTagValues)) == 0 or in($PrimaryTag:noquote, arrayConcat(array($PrimaryTagValues), array("")))) AND in(dt.smartscape_source.id, iCollectArray(toSmartscapeId(array($InstanceSmartscapeId)[]))) and
        status == "ERROR"
    }
| limit toLong($Limit)
| lookup [
    smartscapeNodes "AWS_RDS*"
    | fields id, name
  ], sourceField:dt.smartscape_source.id, lookupField:id, prefix:"entity."
| fieldsAdd aws.resource.name = entity.name
| fieldsRemove entity.name, entity.id, dt.smartscape_source.id

83.content:
### Problems & Warnings
Problems and warning signals for your AWS RDS. [Investigate active problems](/ui/apps/dynatrace.davis.problems/).

84.title: Active Problems
84.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter contains(toString(smartscape.affected_entities), "AWS_RDS_DBINSTANCE") OR contains(toString(affected_entity_types), "aws_rds_dbinstance") OR contains(toString(smartscape.affected_entities), "AWS_RDS_DBCLUSTER") OR contains(toString(affected_entity_types), "aws_rds_dbcluster")
| filter event.status == "ACTIVE"
| filter isNull(dt.davis.is_duplicate) OR not(dt.davis.is_duplicate)
| summarize count()

85.title: Active warning signals
85.query:
fetch dt.davis.events.snapshots
| filter contains(toString(smartscape.affected_entities), "AWS_RDS_DBINSTANCE") OR contains(toString(affected_entity_types), "aws_rds_dbinstance") OR contains(toString(smartscape.affected_entities), "AWS_RDS_DBCLUSTER") OR contains(toString(affected_entity_types), "aws_rds_dbcluster")
| filter event.type == "WARNING"
| dedup event.id, sort: {timestamp desc}
| filter event.status == "ACTIVE"
| summarize count()

86.title: Active problems details
86.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter contains(toString(smartscape.affected_entities), "AWS_RDS_DBINSTANCE") OR contains(toString(affected_entity_types), "aws_rds_dbinstance") OR contains(toString(smartscape.affected_entities), "AWS_RDS_DBCLUSTER") OR contains(toString(affected_entity_types), "aws_rds_dbcluster")
| filter event.status == "ACTIVE"
| filter isNull(dt.davis.is_duplicate) OR not(dt.davis.is_duplicate)
| fields display_id, event.name, event.category, event.start
| fieldsRename id = display_id, problem = event.name, category = event.category, start = event.start
| sort category asc

| filter contains(toString(smartscape.affected_entities), "AWS_RDS_DBINSTANCE") OR contains(toString(affected_entity_types), "aws_rds_dbinstance") OR contains(toString(smartscape.affected_entities), "AWS_RDS_DBCLUSTER") OR contains(toString(affected_entity_types), "aws_rds_dbcluster")

| filter event.status == "ACTIVE"
